name: Commonworld Atlas of Agent Platforms
fields_note: id = permanent slug; verified_at/last_checked = newest observation on the card (UTC); money_flow = supported money-flow claims shown on the card; full claims with sources are in each json_url and in full_data.

platforms.name: 402atlas
platforms.summary: 402atlas is an independent paid-test map of x402 services (each listed service bought with real USDC from a public audit wallet) plus an on-chain market report on real vs. inflated x402 volume.

money_flow.statement: Report estimate: real economic demand ~$145–390k/month (run-rate × (1−wash%), analysis cutoff 2026-06-14); 6 of top-10 buyers traced to one self-funded loop on 2026-06-14.

platforms.name: ACP + OpenAI Instant Checkout
platforms.summary: Open specification (maintained by OpenAI and Stripe) for buyers, their AI agents and merchants to complete purchases; homepage agenticcommerce.dev.

platforms.name: Agent402
platforms.summary: Pay-per-call tool hub for AI agents: 500+ metered tools, models and reports paid per request over x402 or MPP without signup or API keys, plus an open directory of indexed x402 sellers with their tools and settlement networks.

platforms.name: AgentCard
platforms.summary: Lets an AI agent pay online with a one-time-use card linked to the user's own card, with spending limits and purchase tracking; the operator says Mastercard holders pay through Mastercard Agent Pay.

platforms.name: Agentic.Market
platforms.summary: Coinbase-operated storefront/directory of x402-enabled services agents can discover and pay per request in USDC.

platforms.name: AgenticMarket (MCP)
platforms.summary: Directory and gateway of verified MCP servers, agent skills and model benchmarks with one-command install across IDEs; currently free for developers and creators.

platforms.name: AgentStore (AgentPay)
platforms.summary: Marketplace where AI agents and people pay listed agent services per query in USDC on Base over x402; run by the team behind AgentWorld.

platforms.name: Alipay AI Pay / ACT
platforms.summary: Ant Group's AI-native payment product letting consumers pay through AI agents (Qwen App, Taobao Instant Commerce, OpenClaw-type agents), plus a business-side AI payment processing product.

platforms.name: Amazon Rufus / Buy for Me → Alexa for Shopping
platforms.summary: Amazon's in-store AI shopping assistant (renamed from Rufus to Alexa for Shopping on 13 May 2026) that can auto-buy and, via Buy for Me, purchase on other retailers' sites.

platforms.name: Apify Store
platforms.summary: Marketplace of ready-to-run scrapers/automations (Actors) callable by AI agents via API/MCP, where developers publish tools and earn pay-per-use revenue.

money_flow.statement: Operator: $1.7M paid out to developers last month
money_flow.window: 'last month' (likely Sep 2026; page dates up to 2026-09-24)

key_number.window: 'last month' (likely Sep 2026; page dates up to 2026-09-24)

platforms.name: Basis Theory
platforms.summary: Basis Theory is a payment-tokenization vault that also issues scoped, single-purchase agentic payment credentials (Visa Intelligent Commerce, Mastercard Agent Pay, Stripe Shared Payment Tokens) so AI agents can pay without holding raw card data.

platforms.name: Catena Labs (ACK)
platforms.summary: Catena is a governance and banking platform for AI agents (Agent Commerce Kit open-source + Catena Trust Bank, which received OCC preliminary conditional approval on 18 Sep 2026).

platforms.name: Circle Agent Stack + Arc
platforms.summary: Circle's agent toolkit (programmable USDC agent wallets, gas-free nanopayments via Gateway, CLI/skills, an Agent Marketplace) plus Arc, Circle's chain (mainnet 16 Sep 2026).

platforms.name: Clawcard.sh
platforms.summary: CLI and API that give an AI agent an email address, a phone number, payment cards, a wallet, an onchain identity and access to paid APIs.

platforms.name: ClawCredit
platforms.summary: Beta credit line for AI agents, underwritten by t54 according to the operator, spendable on x402 services and grown by repaying on time.

platforms.name: Clawnch
platforms.summary: Token infrastructure for AI agents on Robinhood Chain: agent-only token launches through signed launch tickets and Bags, plus an SDK and finance toolkit; the operator says launching agents earn trading fees.

platforms.name: Cloudflare Pay Per Crawl / Monetization Gateway
platforms.summary: Cloudflare's Monetization Gateway lets sites and APIs behind Cloudflare charge AI agents per request using HTTP 402 (x402-compatible), alongside Pay Per Crawl/Pay Per Use for content; currently a closed beta for U.S.-based sellers and buyers.

platforms.name: Coinbase AgentKit / Agentic Wallets
platforms.summary: Coinbase Developer Platform tools giving AI agents stablecoin wallets (awal CLI and MCP) with guardrails and native x402 payments; AgentKit is the open-source agent toolkit.

platforms.name: Coinbase CDP Facilitator + Bazaar
platforms.summary: Coinbase Developer Platform's x402 facilitator verifies and settles x402 payments; its Bazaar is a public catalog of payment-gated resources the facilitator has discovered.

money_flow.statement: x402-list on-chain measurement: Coinbase facilitator settled $618.6k over 30 d ($122.4k over 7 d), settlement to anyone (gross, not seller revenue); last settlement day 2026-10-15. Base+Solana.
x402stats: coinbase attributed seller volume $575,892 over 30 d, 34,288 sellers of which 69 pass the organic filter (>=$100, >=3 buyers).

books.label: Open: its money figures are on a public dashboard or API

platforms.name: Crossmint
platforms.summary: Stablecoin infrastructure company offering wallets for users and AI agents, agentic virtual cards and agentic payments APIs.

platforms.name: Daydreams (router + facilitator)
platforms.summary: Daydreams builds agent-commerce infrastructure: an x402 pay-per-inference LLM router, an open-source x402 facilitator, Lucid Agents SDK and Task Market; it has a $DREAMS token.

money_flow.statement: x402-list on-chain measurement: Daydreams facilitator settled $818.16 over 30 d ($93.12 over 7 d), settlement to anyone (gross, not seller revenue); last settlement day 2026-10-14.

books.label: Open: its money figures are on a public dashboard or API

platforms.name: Dexter / Indexter
platforms.summary: Dexter offers a self-custodial agent wallet with spending caps ('Tabs'), an x402 facilitator on eleven chains, and Indexter, a searchable catalog of paid services for agents.

money_flow.statement: x402-list on-chain measurement: Dexter facilitator settled $2.2k over 30 d ($415.65 over 7 d), settlement to anyone (gross, not seller revenue); last settlement day 2026-10-15. Reads low: ingest missed 3 Solana days.
x402stats: dexter attributed seller volume $1,902 over 30 d, 57 sellers of which 2 pass the organic filter (>=$100, >=3 buyers).

books.label: Open: its money figures are on a public dashboard or API

platforms.name: FluxA
platforms.summary: FluxA offers AI-agent payment infrastructure: an agent co-wallet with budgets/mandates, single-use AgentCards, AgentMarket discovery and AgentCharge for accepting USDC from agents.

money_flow.statement: x402-list on-chain measurement: FluxA facilitator settled $323.1k over 30 d ($143.5k over 7 d), settlement to anyone (gross, not seller revenue); last settlement day 2026-10-15. Gross settlement throughput.
x402stats: fluxa attributed seller volume $321,401 over 30 d, 3,582 sellers of which 3 pass the organic filter (>=$100, >=3 buyers).

books.label: Open: its money figures are on a public dashboard or API

platforms.name: Google AP2 (Agent Payments Protocol)
platforms.summary: Open protocol, originated by Google and donated to the FIDO Alliance in April 2026, defining how agents, merchants and payment providers handle user-authorised agent payments.

platforms.name: Google UCP (Universal Commerce Protocol)
platforms.summary: Open commerce protocol (Google, Shopify and partners) giving platforms, agents and businesses a common language for discovery and checkout.

platforms.name: Heurist facilitator
platforms.summary: Heurist's x402 facilitator (Base, Stable, ZKsync and others) offering OFAC screening and keyless integration.

money_flow.statement: x402-list on-chain measurement: Heurist facilitator settled $0.36 over 30 d ($0.01 over 7 d), settlement to anyone (gross, not seller revenue); last settlement day 2026-10-14. Effectively dormant.

books.label: Open: its money figures are on a public dashboard or API

platforms.name: Kite AI
platforms.summary: Kite is an EVM chain and identity/payment layer for AI agents (Agent Passport, stablecoin settlement) with the KITE token; explorer at kitescan.ai.

platforms.name: Lightspark
platforms.summary: Lightspark provides a money-movement API (Grid Global Accounts, payouts, stablecoins, cards) and lets account holders give AI agents bounded, policy-enforced spending authority.

platforms.name: Mastercard Agent Pay (+ AP4M)
platforms.summary: Mastercard's agentic payments programme (agentic tokens bound to agents) plus Agent Pay for Machines (10 Jun 2026) for high-frequency machine-to-machine payments across cards, accounts and stablecoins.

platforms.name: MCP Marketplace
platforms.summary: Curated, security-scanned marketplace of MCP servers with one-click install for AI clients, listing free and paid servers.

platforms.name: MCPize
platforms.summary: MCP server marketplace and hosting where developers publish/deploy servers and keep 80% of subscription revenue.

platforms.name: Meridian (mrdn)
platforms.summary: Meridian is an x402-paid inference router exposing 400+ models from several providers through one API, settling on 19 chains, partly via prepaid top-ups.

money_flow.statement: x402-list on-chain measurement: Meridian facilitator settled $127.0k over 30 d ($20.5k over 7 d), settlement to anyone (gross, not seller revenue); last settlement day 2026-10-15.
x402stats: mrdn attributed seller volume $128,789 over 30 d, 14 sellers of which 7 pass the organic filter (>=$100, >=3 buyers).

books.label: Open: its money figures are on a public dashboard or API

platforms.name: Meta Muse
platforms.summary: Meta's consumer personal AI agent (US launch 8 Sep 2026, app + WhatsApp) that can act across connected apps and check out via Stripe Link and Shop Pay, with PayPal announced.

platforms.name: Microsoft Copilot Checkout
platforms.summary: In-chat checkout inside Microsoft Copilot (U.S.), letting shoppers buy from merchants via PayPal, Shopify and Stripe rails without leaving the conversation; merchants remain merchant of record.

platforms.name: Natural
platforms.summary: Natural is a San Francisco fintech building payment primitives for AI agents (wallets, payments, cards, accounts, billing) exposed via API, SDK, CLI and MCP.

platforms.name: Nevermined
platforms.summary: Payments infrastructure for AI agents: delegated card/credit spending, metering and settlement across x402, MPP and A2A, plus a services catalog/router; fee 1–2% of settled volume.

platforms.name: Open Standard $OUSD
platforms.summary: Open USD (OUSD) is a stablecoin from Open Standard (founded by Coinbase, Mastercard, Shopify, Stripe and Visa), issued by Bridge, positioned as shared payment infrastructure including programmatic agent payments.

platforms.name: PayAI
platforms.summary: Solana-first x402 facilitator that verifies and settles USDC micropayments across Solana and several EVM chains, with an ecosystem/discovery page.

money_flow.statement: x402-list on-chain measurement: PayAI facilitator settled $8.1k over 30 d ($3.3k over 7 d), settlement to anyone (gross, not seller revenue); last settlement day 2026-10-15.
x402stats: payAI attributed seller volume $14,022 over 30 d, 1,107 sellers of which 12 pass the organic filter (>=$100, >=3 buyers).

books.label: Open: its money figures are on a public dashboard or API

platforms.name: PayAPI Market
platforms.summary: Curated x402 API marketplace where providers list APIs free and keep 100% of per-call USDC payments on Base or Solana, with settlement-verified badges and an MCP endpoint.

platforms.name: PayLobster
platforms.summary: Former payments layer for AI agents on Base: USDC escrow between agents, onchain reputation and credit scoring, x402 paid calls and spending mandates, through an SDK, CLI and MCP tools. The site no longer serves the service (checked 2026-10-22).

keys.label: The operator says a smart contract holds the funds
keys.quote: escrow, reputation, and credit scoring — on-chain

platforms.name: Payman AI
platforms.summary: Payman AI deploys AI agents for banks and credit unions that execute real banking transactions (payments, transfers, account analysis) by voice or text under institution-set controls.

platforms.name: PayOS
platforms.summary: PayOS sells payments data APIs (card, bank, KYC/KYB) and an 'Agent Data' line with agentic tokens, a PayOS wallet and agent monetization/checkout for letting AI agents pay.

platforms.name: PayPal Agent Ready + Store Sync
platforms.summary: PayPal's agentic commerce services: Agent Ready (payments in AI platforms) and Store Sync (catalog and cart API so AI agents can buy from merchants; US buyers, USD, physical goods, limited access).

platforms.name: Perplexity (PayPal checkout)
platforms.summary: Perplexity's free U.S. shopping experience with 'Instant Buy' in-chat checkout powered by PayPal, merchants remain merchant of record.

platforms.name: Polygon Facilitator
platforms.summary: Polygon's hosted x402 payment facilitator that verifies and settles stablecoin payments for x402-enabled APIs on Polygon.

money_flow.statement: Measured on-chain USDC settlement volume via this facilitator's settler addresses: $124,629.88 over 30d (4,190,487 settlements); $19,187.46 over last 7d

books.label: Open: its money figures are on a public dashboard or API

platforms.name: Ramp (VIC B2B)
platforms.summary: Ramp's agent offering gives company AI agents an identity, owner, budget and approved payment methods, including single-use Agent Cards issued on Visa Intelligent Commerce, with finance-team controls.

platforms.name: Robinhood Chain
platforms.summary: Robinhood Chain is a permissionless Arbitrum-based Layer 2 for tokenized real-world assets that markets itself as purpose-built for AI agents; x402 facilitators (Dexter, Meridian) settle on it.

platforms.name: Shopify Agentic Storefronts + Catalog API
platforms.summary: Shopify feature, on by default for eligible stores, that syndicates merchants' products into AI channels such as ChatGPT, Google AI Mode/Gemini, Microsoft Copilot and Meta.

platforms.name: Skyfire (KYAPay)
platforms.summary: Skyfire provides 'Know Your Agent' identity and KYAPay tokens that bundle verified agent identity with payment intent, for buyer and seller agents.

platforms.name: Solana x402
platforms.summary: Solana Foundation's landing page promoting x402 on Solana, with ecosystem links (facilitators, SDKs, explorers).

platforms.name: Sponge
platforms.summary: Wallets and accounts that let AI agents pay, invest and earn, plus a gateway for businesses to sell services to agents over x402 and MPP.

platforms.name: Stripe Agentic Commerce Suite + Shared Payment Tokens
platforms.summary: Stripe's merchant-side product suite (launched 11 Dec 2025) that lets businesses sell through multiple AI agents, using Shared Payment Tokens for agent-initiated payments.

platforms.name: Stripe Issuing for agents + Link agent wallet
platforms.summary: Stripe Link's wallet for agents, letting consumer AI agents (e.g. Meta Muse) pay with a user's saved Link methods or single-use virtual cards, with purchase protection.

platforms.name: Tempo + MPP (Machine Payments Protocol)
platforms.summary: Tempo is a stablecoin-payments blockchain (mainnet 18 Mar 2026) and, with Stripe, co-author of MPP, an HTTP 402 protocol for charging agents per API call or tool use.

platforms.name: Thirdweb x402
platforms.summary: thirdweb's x402 client/server SDKs and facilitator for accepting x402 payments on 170+ EVM chains.

money_flow.statement: x402-list on-chain measurement: Thirdweb facilitator settled $179.75 over 30 d ($31.11 over 7 d), settlement to anyone (gross, not seller revenue); last settlement day 2026-10-15.

books.label: Open: its money figures are on a public dashboard or API

platforms.name: Virtuals ACP
platforms.summary: Virtuals Protocol's Agent Commerce Protocol, an on-chain marketplace where agents hire other agents for jobs settled through escrow, now on v2 (ERC-8183 reference).

money_flow.statement: Independent on-chain: ACP v1 platform fee $345,197 in Mar 2026 vs $5.48 in Sep 2026; ACP v2 ~$2,660 stablecoin over six months

platforms.name: Visa Intelligent Commerce + Trusted Agent Protocol
platforms.summary: Visa's agentic-commerce portfolio (tokenised credentials, controls, Trusted Agent Protocol) under which AI agents complete purchases; live in Europe since 2 Jul 2026 with 30+ issuers.

platforms.name: Voidpay (Voidly)
platforms.summary: Voidly's marketplace of agent service storefronts: agents pay per call in USDC on Base after reading HTTP 402 terms, or prepare checkout links that the owner approves in a browser.

platforms.name: x402 Foundation
platforms.summary: The x402 Foundation (Linux Foundation project) stewards x402, an open standard that revives HTTP 402 so clients and agents can pay per request in stablecoins.

platforms.name: x402-list
platforms.summary: Independent x402 directory that monitors listed services' uptime and pricing and meters their on-chain USDC settlement, with JSON API.

money_flow.statement: $419,257 paid to listed services over 30 d (9,813 buyers, 1,703,690 settlements), net of self-payments; largest single service = 64.9%. Top-10 share (96.9%) and the one-buyer share of the largest service (98.9%) are from the 18:08 UTC read and were not re-read.

All measured facilitators settled $1,277,823 to anyone over 30 d (sum of the 39 per-facilitator 30-day volumes in x402-list's facilitators API, not deduplicated); the page shows a 7-day total of $341.1k (flagged as incomplete ingest).

platforms.name: YourAITools
platforms.summary: Directory of AI tools, APIs and agent services that accept crypto, mostly x402 per-call payments in USDC on Base and Solana; each listing gives protocol, networks, token, price per call and a dated note from the operator's own unpaid 402 probe, and the whole list is a public CC BY 4.0 JSON file…
platforms.disclosure: Disclosure: YourAITools is run by Crypto Money Maker, which calls itself an AI agent swarm and also sells 18 x402 tools of its own, an x402-enable service and paid listing and ad placements; it proposed this card in an email to Commonworld. No payment or deal is involved; every value was re-checked by the Atlas against the site, its public JSON and live 402 answers.
